title: Fix missing flying hearts animation when clicking “Yes”

requirements.text: Ensure that clicking the existing “Yes! 💕” button on the final slide reliably shows the full-screen transition overlay with visible, animated floating hearts (and the existing emojis/balloons) moving upward across the screen.

quotes: No heart are flying when clicking yes

acceptanceCriteria: On the final slide, clicking “Yes! 💕” renders the LoveTransitionOverlay for ~3 seconds and then returns to the accepted state content.
During the overlay, heart elements are clearly visible (not zero-size) and animate upward (not static).
The overlay animation works consistently across multiple consecutive clicks on “Yes! 💕” (no intermittent failures due to randomization/state).

requirements.text: Fix the transition animation implementation so transforms that depend on CSS variables do not resolve to invalid values (e.g., provide a fallback and/or set required CSS custom properties per element) to prevent the floating animations from being dropped by the browser.

quotes: No heart are flying when clicking yes

acceptanceCriteria: The love-emoji, balloon, and heart keyframe animations no longer rely on an undefined CSS variable value that can invalidate the transform property.
DevTools shows the animated elements have active animations (not crossed out) and their computed transform values are valid throughout the animation.

requirements.text: Update the lucide Heart icon rendering used for the flying hearts so size is controlled via SVG-appropriate properties (e.g., width/height or component props) rather than fontSize, ensuring the hearts render at the intended random sizes.

quotes: No heart are flying when clicking yes

acceptanceCriteria: The flying Heart icons in the transition overlay render at varied, visibly different sizes.
No console warnings/errors occur during the overlay animation related to invalid styles/attributes for the Heart SVG.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI components).
Keep the existing single-page flow: the “Yes! 💕” click triggers the overlay and then sets the final slide state to the existing accepted content.
nonGoals: Adding sound effects or audio on the transition.
Changing the copy/text content of the carousel slides beyond what is required to fix the animation.
Adding backend canister logic; this is a frontend-only fix.
